linkedin.copy:
Why DeFi Lending Is Modularizing: The Risk Management War Among Morpho, Euler, and Aave - Tiger Research Reports requires a structural shift away from pooled lending risk.

During market turbulence, decentralized money markets face two major bottlenecks: mempool congestion and shared pool contagion. When bad debt accumulates in a shared pool, passive liquidity providers absorb the haircut.

Vanna isolates credit execution at the smart contract level on Stellar Soroban. Each borrower manages leverage inside an independent SmartAccount sandbox. Deficits remain quarantined without haircutting global lending reserves.
